Computes a byte count from a2[9] (bit field sized to whole bytes), copies a2[5] data via qmemcpy, appends the original encoded value byte, then copies a data pointer from UtilityFunction_6a90 (00586A90). On the first call (counter this+0x408 was 0) stores the bitmask from BitmaskGenerationFromBitArray (00586DE0) at this+0x40C.
